## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      10 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 7 jul 2026 - 27 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Rachel C_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
            2. _hjgjkhfhgdsdfhgjklhfhdsrueytiu_, 18 sept 2026, 1/5: "As a pro user for the last few years, it’s a shame to see forest just keep going downhill - from adding AI slop trees, constant buggy updates, and now finally the new UI which makes returning to the home screen after planting a tree multiple clicks, I’m writing a review to hopefully get things to change. It’s a big shame, I hope they get their act together and remember what the core idea about the app is about."
            3. _Silk14789_, 16 sept 2026, 1/5: "The developers have forced a buggy and fastidious update that ruins the app for me. It seems they went for sth “aesthetic” and forgot this a productivity app. At least give us the option to use the old UI back!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
